note: A service listed here has no control of its own. The fix is a gap record, not a rewrite of the advanced view.

gaps.label: Operations Hub
gaps.reason: No input or write control: 'Run batch' and 'Pin snapshot' only toast, and the gate switches are display-only.
gaps.evidence: northstar-os-ui/src/pages/Hub.jsx:38-39 — 'Pin snapshot' and 'Run batch' only call toast(); :69 service rows and :91 quick actions call navigate(); no input, select or request is created by the page.

gaps.label: The Ledger
gaps.reason: No control at all: the page reads credits and model posture and offers nothing to act on.
gaps.evidence: northstar-os-ui/src/pages/Ledger.jsx:11-22 performs two reads and renders Metric tiles; the file contains no button, input, select or textarea.

gaps.label: The Watch
gaps.reason: No control: no watch/unwatch, no threshold, no scan trigger.
gaps.evidence: northstar-os-ui/src/pages/TheWatch.jsx:10-27 — one scanner read, then a render; no input, button or select in the file.

gaps.label: RankLedger
gaps.reason: No control: no sort selector, no band threshold, no export.
gaps.evidence: northstar-os-ui/src/pages/RankLedger.jsx:10-30 — reads the scanner and sorts in memory; the file has no form control.

gaps.label: The Rival Board
gaps.reason: No control: no risk threshold, no seller filter, no drill-down.
gaps.evidence: northstar-os-ui/src/pages/RivalBoard.jsx:10-27 — one read and a derived posture column; no control exists.

gaps.label: Account
gaps.reason: No control: entitlements and usage are read-only; no plan change, export or seat request.
gaps.evidence: App.jsx:250 mounts pages/customer/AccountStatus.jsx for /account; northstar-os-ui/src/pages/customer/AccountStatus.jsx:14-15 performs two reads and the file has no button or input.

gaps.label: Foundation
gaps.reason: Only a Refresh button that repeats the same twelve reads; no probe trigger, no approval decision, no export.
gaps.evidence: northstar-os-ui/src/foundation/pages/FoundationStatus.jsx:31-43 fires twelve distinct reads; :88 Refresh re-runs them. Nothing on the page accepts input or writes.

gaps.label: Onboarding & Plan
gaps.reason: Landing page only: the only actions are navigation to /beta/accept and /sign-in.
gaps.evidence: northstar-os-ui/src/pages/public/BetaLanding.jsx:41-42 — 'Accept Invitation' and 'Sign In' call navigate(); the file imports no API client.

gaps.label: Support
gaps.reason: Static section: no ticket form and no contact action; the ticket queue lives at /support.
gaps.evidence: northstar-os-ui/src/pages/public/BetaLanding.jsx:53-65 renders section#support only when the hash is #support; the section contains two paragraphs and no control.

gaps.label: Tester Dashboard
gaps.reason: No input: org drill-down, Export Report and Audit Log are all navigation; no cohort filter or account action.
gaps.evidence: northstar-os-ui/src/pages/admin/Overview.jsx:105 'Open' navigates to the org page, :152 'Export Report' and 'Audit Log' navigate; the page has no input or select.

gaps.label: Listing Guardian
gaps.reason: No input or write: New Rule only toasts, History navigates, Escalate navigates; no diff review or rule creation.
gaps.evidence: northstar-os-ui/src/pages/internal/ListingGuardian.jsx:85 'New Rule' and :86 'History' only toast or navigate, :75 escalate navigates to Commerce Ops; the tabs switch a subview and no input or write exists.

gaps.label: Keyword Tracker
gaps.reason: Track New, Reports and Verify only toast; no search input, no term add, no threshold.
gaps.evidence: northstar-os-ui/src/pages/internal/KeywordTracker.jsx:59 'Track New' and :60 'Reports' only toast; :83 'Verify' calls a toast helper (:verified). No input or write exists.

gaps.label: Competitor Monitor
gaps.reason: No control: no ASIN add, no refresh, no comparison selector.
gaps.evidence: northstar-os-ui/src/pages/internal/CompetitorMonitor.jsx:10-80 — two reads and two tables; the page has no input, button or select.
